dashboard.title: Network status
dashboard.unavailableReason: The engine has not produced an evaluation yet.

score.withheldReason: Coverage is {coverage} out of 100, below the minimum required. The areas that were measured are still reported.

factor.unknown: Factor this interface does not recognise: {code}
factor.ConfigurationUnavailable: The source does not provide its configuration: DNSSEC validation, encrypted transports and resolver settings cannot be assessed.
factor.ClassificationUnavailable: No classification list is available. Without lists every domain is unclassified, which does not mean there is no tracking.
factor.ObservationInsufficient: Too few queries observed: {queries} out of the {minimum} required. A network barely observed is not a network protected.
factor.DomainActivityUnavailable: The source does not report activity per domain: the blocked share cannot be assessed.
factor.DnssecValidationDisabled: DNSSEC validation is off: answers are not checked against tampering.
factor.EncryptedTransportsAbsent: No encrypted transport is enabled: devices query the server in the clear.
factor.QueryMinimisationDisabled: Query name minimisation is off: authoritative servers are told more than they need.
factor.ClientSubnetForwardingEnabled: Client subnet forwarding is on: external servers are told which part of the network a query came from.
factor.EncryptedQueryShare: Queries received over an encrypted transport: {share}.
factor.FailedQueryShare: Queries the service could not satisfy: {share}.
factor.NoTrafficObserved: No traffic observed in the period: use of encrypted transports and errors cannot be assessed.
factor.TrackingExposureNone: No known tracking observed. Domains absent from every list stay unclassified, so the figure is a lower bound.
factor.TrackingExposureMeasured: Queries towards domains known for tracking, advertising or analytics: {share} of the total. The figure is a lower bound.
factor.TrackingBlockingMeasured: Queries towards those domains that were blocked: {share} out of {queries}.
factor.TrackingBlockingUntested: No query towards a known tracking domain: the filter was not put to the test.
factor.ThreatExposureNone: No known threat and no suspicious domain observed. The lists assert what they recognise, so the figure is a lower bound.
factor.ThreatExposureSuspiciousOnly: No confirmed threat. Domains reported as suspicious: {suspicious}. The report is not confirmed.
factor.ThreatExposureMeasured: Confirmed threat domains observed: {confirmed}. Suspicious domains: {suspicious}.
factor.ThreatBlockingMeasured: Queries towards domains at risk that were blocked: {share} out of {queries}.
factor.ThreatBlockingUntested: No query towards a known threat domain: the filter was not put to the test.
factor.EnginesNotImplemented: Requires the Device Engine and the Alert Engine, not built yet.
factor.SourceUnreachable: The source could not be reached.
factor.FilterListsAbsent: No filter list configured: filtering has no effect.
factor.ObservationContinuity: Periods observed: {observed} out of the {expected} expected.
factor.ObservationContinuityUnknown: No period was expected, so continuity cannot be judged.
factor.AcquisitionReliabilityUnknown: Reliability of the acquisition cannot be assessed: attempts are not recorded yet.

domains.title: Observed domains
domains.unavailableReason: The engine did not answer. This says nothing about what the network contacted.
domains.empty: No domain was recorded in the last observed period.
domains.unclassifiedNote: This domain appears in none of the installed lists. That does not mean it is safe: it means we did not recognise it.

confidenceNote.High: The list names this exact domain.
confidenceNote.Medium: The list names a parent domain, and the category was extended to this one. A reasonable inference, not a direct statement.

domains.hourly: The list covers the last twenty four hours, or those observed so far if the installation is more recent.
domains.hoursObserved: {observed} hour observed out of the {requested} requested | {observed} hours observed out of the {requested} requested
domains.inProgress: The last hour is still in progress.

unclassified.label: What “unclassified” means
unclassified.note: The domain appears in none of the installed lists. That does not mean it is safe: it means we did not recognise it. Lists say which domains track you, not which ones do not.

periodBounded.label: Why you see a span and not a time
periodBounded.note: The source reports data grouped by the hour, so we know in which hour the domain was contacted but not in which minute. Showing a precise time would be an invention.

coverage.label: What coverage is
coverage.note: How much of the evaluation could actually be measured, out of 100. What was not observed is excluded from the calculation rather than counted as zero, so missing data neither worsens nor improves the result.

lowerBound.label: What a lower bound is
lowerBound.note: The real value is at least the one shown, and may be higher. We recognise the domains present in the lists: the ones no list knows about stay out of the count.

notMeasurable.label: What “not measurable” means
notMeasurable.note: We could not observe that area: the data is missing, not the result. It is different from a bad result, and it is why those points count neither for nor against the total.
